description: This file implements the core logic of an Analytics system, including event handling, configuration parsing, backend communication, and time synchronization. It defines classes for configuration, event mapping, and the main AnalyticsImplementation class that manages event queues, threading, and backend interactions.

classes.name: AnalyticsConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for analytics settings, including event mapping file path and backend library name.

classes.name: AnalyticsImplementation
classes.description: Main class managing event processing, configuration, threading, and backend communication for analytics.

classes.name: AnalyticsImplementation::EventMapper
classes.description: Helper class for mapping event names based on configuration.

methods.name: SendEvent
methods.description: Public method to enqueue an event for processing and sending.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Initializes the analytics system with configuration and backend setup.

methods.name: ActionLoop
methods.description: Main thread loop handling event dispatch, time validation, and shutdown.

methods.name: IsSysTimeValid
methods.description: Checks if system time and timezone are valid for timestamping.

methods.name: SendEventToBackend
methods.description: Transmits a processed event to the configured backend.

methods.name: ParseEventsMapFile
methods.description: Reads and parses the event mapping configuration file.

methods.name: GetCurrentTimestampInMs
methods.description: Returns current system timestamp in milliseconds.

methods.name: ConvertUptimeToTimestampInMs
methods.description: Converts an uptime duration to an absolute timestamp.
